body:
Directly continues selfhost/lexer.prn + selfhost/parser.prn + selfhost/region.prn. New selfhost/emit.prn: a real, faithful PARENA-language port of src/emit.c, deliberately scoped to VS0's own ORIGINAL, narrow domain-3 DoD acceptance bar (src/emit.h's own documented v0: with-arena/let/alloc, char* the only inferred type), not the current 5000+ line C emitter grown to serve the whole real stdlib. This completes a real, working, end-to-end vertical slice of a PARENA-in-PARENA pipeline: lexer -> parser -> region -> emit, verified by actually running examples/valid_only.prn's own real source through all four, compiling the REAL resulting C with a real gcc -std=c99 -Wall -Wextra -pedantic -Werror, linking it against the SAME real tests/integration/driver_valid_only.c domain 4's own check already uses, and actually RUNNING it -- the driver's own assert(strcmp(result, 'parsed_data') == 0) passes against the selfhost emitter's own real output. Still compiled BY the existing C-based parena-c, but the pipeline's own real output is now proven correct end to end. Real design departures: no arena-typed pointer-vs-local-value tracking via a linked Scope-with-parent chain (flat-Vec substitute); every match used as a non-tail value extracted into its own function (the same confirmed VS0 emitter gap region.prn's own bug list documents); mangle deliberately narrow (hyphen-only); return type hard-coded char*. 14 real assertions in tests/test_selfhost_emit.c. Full local suite + bazel build/test + real mingw cross-compile all clean, zero regressions. CI green on all 4 platform jobs. Honest gap noted: CI's own workflow only re-runs the original C-based test_lexer_parser/test_region/test_emit plus editor-demo builds -- the new test-selfhost-* Makefile targets aren't wired into CI, so their only verification so far is local (this dev box + mingw compile-only for Windows, no real macOS run). NORTHSTAR.md's own Self-hosting section extended. PARENA commit d55608b, release v0.88.0.

⚓ ☃
title: v0.88.0: real fourth step -- emit.prn completes a working PARENA-in-PARENA vertical slice
